Short circuit protection on all outputs
MTBF: 250K hours of continuous operation at 55°C, 75% output load
Delivers a massive 3200W total capacity to support multi-GPU configurations and high-performance computing clusters.
Engineered with Low Ripple & Noise technology to safeguard your most sensitive workstation components.
Achieve peak energy conversion with 80 Plus
Titanium certification, minimizing thermal waste during intense 8K rendering or AI model training.
Designed to operate flawlessly at high altitudes, far exceeding standard consumer grade limitations.
Maintains a staggering 250,000 hours MTBF even under harsh 55°C operating conditions.
Integrated PMBus 1.2 support allows for real-time monitoring of voltage, current, and temperature directly through the motherboard.
Delivering ultra-stable power with low ripple & noise, TWINS CRPS supports multi-GPU, and enterprise-grade systems, perfect for workstations, servers, and HPC clusters.
Providing stable power for high-wattage GPU arrays.
Reliable operation in compact, mission-critical server environments.
The silent backbone for 3D creators and data scientists.

Our dedicated Power Distribution Boards(PDB) are engineered specifically for CRPS modules, ensuring lossless power delivery and simplified cable management for system integration requiring ATX form factor.
The power supply fan will start once the CRPS unit is powered on.
Follow these steps to install the CRPS power supply:
Carefully slide the CRPS power supply fully into the PDB.
Ensure the power supply clicks into place and is securely installed.
*SATA/Floppy combined cable. Floppy with dedicated 500mm branch.
